rules.title: PRDs define success metrics
rules.statement: Every PRD states measurable success metrics with targets.

check.question: Does the PRD define measurable success metrics with targets?

source.quote: State how you will measure success

rules.title: PRDs list non-goals
rules.statement: Every PRD lists what is out of scope.

source.quote: List what you are not doing

rules.title: Designs explain rollback
rules.statement: design.md says how to roll the change back.

check.question: Does the design explain how to roll the change back?

source.quote: Describe how you would roll back

rules.title: PRDs state latency targets
rules.statement: User-facing lookups state a p95 latency target per region.

check.question: Does the PRD state measurable latency targets for user-facing operations?

source.quote: State latency targets for anything a user waits on

rules.title: PRDs plan rollout and rollback
rules.statement: Every PRD orders its rollout and says how to roll back.

check.question: Does the rollout say the order of steps and how to roll back?

source.quote: Say how you will roll out and how you would roll back

rules.title: PRD reviews within 5 working days
rules.statement: Reviewers respond to a PRD within 5 working days.

source.quote: Reviewers respond within five working days

rules.title: 1:1 briefs are preparation aids
rules.statement: Use 1:1 briefs to prepare conversations, never as performance evidence or for pay and promotion decisions.

source.quote: Briefs prepare a conversation; they are never performance evidence

rules.title: Reports see the same evidence
rules.statement: Share brief sources with the report and invite their context before the 1:1.

source.quote: the report sees the same evidence

rules.title: Design approvals need a staff engineer
rules.statement: Managers do not approve high-tier designs on behalf of a staff engineer.

source.quote: High-risk designs are approved by a staff engineer
